# Model test inputs

`meeting.png` is Tracefolio-generated Chinese meeting text (SHA256 393bd0af5744cf1984ba3f48c48b68a06ee7c006f1eaca1320cc93eae0f3a47e), distributed under AGPL-3.0-only.

`group.png` is a derivative of the NASA/KSC public-domain STS-114 crew photo. Attribution, source and exact derivative hash are retained in `group.source.json`. It exercises detections and 17-point pose output; it is not independent model accuracy truth.

Actual OCR/vision tests use explicit runtime inputs. Stored private-project artifacts and research logs are not part of this repository.
